subject: POC trial planning — Serenity Health (next steps & readout scheduling)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@serenityhealth.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@serenityhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC recap + proposed next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed plan to keep momentum: 

Summary
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference runtime for patient-message generation and chart summarization across a 4-week POC.
- Success criteria (high level): throughput >= 50 reqs/sec at 200-token median, average 95th percentile latency < 300ms, output quality score >= 4/5 on provided eval prompts for summaries.

Proposed POC plan (week-by-week)
1) Week 0 (this week): Access + baseline tests — provide test dataset, grant network access to staging, baseline perf + quality.
2) Week 1-2: Integration + tuning — implement surrogate routing and KV caching, run baseline vs optimized runs.
3) Week 3: Scale testing + soak — sustained load and failure scenarios.
4) Week 4: Final readout + exec decision (presentation + recommendation).

Ownership / next steps
- Redwood: Marcus will own setup and perf baselines; Rishi will own evaluation prompts and quality scoring.
- Serenity: Alyssa to provide sample dataset and procurement contact (if not already looped).
- Action: Alyssa/Ben to confirm dataset and contract procurement contact by EOD Friday.

Attachments: serenity_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (success criteria template), redwood_poc_playbook.pdf (POC checklist).

If that looks good I'll send calendar invites for Week 0 kickoff and tentative final readout slots (two options).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@serenityhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@serenityhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed next steps

Marissa — really appreciate the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side after syncing with engineering and procurement: 

- Timeline: we probably need to shift the baseline week a few days later to account for data sanitization on our side. Can we kickoff Mon May 24 instead of May 17?
- Success criteria: the quality scoring framework looks good, but can we add an acceptance condition for hallucination rate (< 2% on a 500-sample set)?
- Procurement: looping in procurement (procure@serenityhealth.com) — they'll start a standard SOW + NDA review once we confirm timeline and estimated trial capacity.

Alyssa and I are aligned on the decision process: exec readout + go/no-go by the end of the 4th week; procurement will work in parallel for contract prep.

I'll attach a short internal checklist we use for POCs (send over if helpful).

Thanks,
Ben
Director of Product Engineering | Serenity Health

- Option A: Tue June 22, 2027 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed June 23, 2027 14:00–15:00 PT

What we'll deliver at the readout:
- Summary of tests and key metrics vs targets (latency, throughput, hallucination, quality score)
- Demo of sample outputs and failure modes
- Recommendation (go / no-go) and suggested next-contract steps (dedicated capacity vs hosted).

Procurement: if you can start contract checklist and provide an example SOW timeline, we'll align the final recommendation with estimated committed capacity and pricing.

Attachments: redwood_poc_playbook.pdf (updated).

Action items: Alyssa/Ben to confirm preferred readout slot by EOD May 28; Procurement to acknowledge SOW kickoff.

Cheers,
Marissa
